title: Bridging the Gap: In-Context Learning for Modeling Human Disagreement
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the capacity of LLMs to model human disagreement and capture multiple perspectives in subjective NLP tasks through In-Context Learning. While the tasks used for evaluation (hate speech and abusive language detection) have ethical dimensions, the research objective is methodological and focused on perspectivism, rather than benchmarking specific religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
